mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and a rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a shift in demand from housing to consumption, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the rebalancing.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST decline and RSAFS rise does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven expansion (INDPRO > 105), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and an increase in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals strong housing demand, which supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
